messages:
anna: heads up — after shading the kotlin-client into our v2 artifact I'm hitting a runtime failure when streaming embeddings (ndjson). stack says: NoClassDefFoundError: com/fasterxml/jackson/core/JsonFactory

mike: did you relocate com.fasterxml packages in the shadowJar? can you paste the shadow block from build.gradle.kts?

anna: we had this: 
```
shadowJar {
  relocate('com.fasterxml', 'com.redwood.shaded.com.fasterxml')
  minimize()
}
```
I ran `./gradlew :client:shadowJar` and saw the error at runtime (only in the shaded artifact).

kevin: minimize() is the usual suspect — it can strip classes used via reflection or ServiceLoader. also make sure to merge service files for jackson so providers still load. try `mergeServiceFiles()` and exclude jackson from minimize.

mike: agreed. sample to try:
```
shadowJar {
  relocate 'com.fasterxml', 'com.redwood.shaded.com.fasterxml'
  mergeServiceFiles()
  minimize {
    exclude 'com/redwood/shaded/com/fasterxml/**'
  }
}
```
that preserves jackson artifacts and relocates service descriptors.

sara: small gotcha we hit elsewhere — OkHttp will drop Authorization on 307/302 redirect by default. if your NDJSON endpoint redirects (e.g., for region routing) the auth header can disappear and the server closes the stream. either disable followRedirects for that call or use an Authenticator/interceptor to reapply the header after redirect.

anna: good call — I saw intermittent `401` then `unexpected end of stream` in logs. switching to an interceptor fixed the auth loss locally.

anna: after adding `mergeServiceFiles()` + excluding jackson from minimize the NoClassDefFoundError went away, but integration tests are flaky: sometimes okhttp throws `java.io.IOException: unexpected end of stream` while reading NDJSON chunks after a redirect.

kevin: streaming + redirects is hairy. recommendations:
- keep connection pooling stable: `new ConnectionPool(5, 5, TimeUnit.MINUTES)`
- set `retryOnConnectionFailure(true)`
- avoid closing the Response body in an interceptor before the client finishes reading
- consider `followRedirects(false)` at client level and handle the redirect explicitly in code that can reattach headers

mike: I'll open a small PR that:
- updates shadowJar to `mergeServiceFiles()` and the minimize exclude for jackson
- adds an integration test that simulates chunked ndjson + 307 redirect and verifies header is preserved when using our interceptor
- bumps the client to create an OkHttp instance with an explicit ConnectionPool so we don't rely on default pooled settings

anna: that would be super helpful. I'm also going to run the shaded jar against the Dedicated staging region (same routing behavior) to validate.

mike: pushed PR -> #4829. pinging @anna @sara for review, it touches packaging + one small okhttp config change.

anna: reviewing now. quick note in the PR about why we excluded jackson from minimize would be great (reflection/service loader).

kevin: once merged, let's cut a canary and run the NDJSON load test overnight — if stable we can roll to prod tomorrow.
